causal_findings: Every R1 bracket failure is on the q > K(h_above) endpoint branch; no negative-q or q<K(h_above) branch failures were observed.
Most failing roots lie extremely close to K(h_above), with median relative gaps of order 3e-12 for B12 and O13.
Simply moving the q bracket endpoint from a 1e-12 offset to nextafter(K,+inf) recovers only about 5-7 percent of failures with the existing R1 quadrature.

In representative failures the nearest first-segment GL8 lane remains about 1e-5 to 1e-3 cm away from h_above, so the endpoint contribution is under-resolved even when q is moved closer to K(h_above).
R1 broad-path accuracy on valid probes remains good; the unresolved issue is endpoint-local.
recommended_R2_change: Keep R1 quarter-decade segmentation and GL8 density, but cluster the first segment quadrature deterministically toward h_above and use the closest representable physical q bracket endpoint on the q>K(h_above) branch.
hard_guards: Do not change R1 broad-path segmentation density or accuracy thresholds in R2.
Do not interpret this diagnostic as R1 qualification.
R2 must remain hard bounded and material-independent.
The near-saturation precomputed table route remains closed.
